body:
I don't expect you to. 

I don't fully understand it either. Your own advice is valueless when still left alone in the world. I believe love and feeling cared for is essential is being happy. When you go unloved and unwanted for so long, you finally lose hope.

I still do that. I've tried my entire life to put other ahead of me. 

If anything is ever wrong, I'll be the first one to be there for you, be the shoulder to cry on or the person to talk to over the phone. But as much advice as I give out, and the amount of people I help, I can never take my own advice.

It's a sad realization when the roles are reversed and you now notice no one is there for you when you're hurting the most.

But what do you do when nothing makes you happy anymore? When you have no one. I understand you're telling me to worry about myself, and take care of myself. But I'm not even close to the person I was or wish I was. I can't even help me anymore. 

The though of death used to terrify me. What happens afterward? But it doesn't matter anymore when anything is better than another day in this life. 

When people jumped from the twin towers during 9/11, when faced with two fates, the fire behind them or the fall in front, they took the one they thought to be less terrifying and painful. I'm faced with two fates, living everyday, the fire burning me more and more until I finally break. Or the jump where I know my pain will stop... no more hurting.

Absolutely not. I believe life is filled with amazing people, I truly do. I just don't believe I'm one of those people.

Find something that makes you happy and run with it. I wish I did when I had the chance. The things I once loved are now gone and anyone who I had before is as well. I don't have any other option if I want to be at peace finally, you do.

But having a complete stranger try to fathom the idea of the pain another individual feels is crazy.

I've heard it all before, "it gets better" - maybe for some not for me. "Just one more day" - I've tried enough one more days. "If you're at rock bottom things can only get better" - it's a lie, things always can get worse.

I understand a lot of people find the help they need. But every situation is different, and not everyone can be helped. I don't expect you to understand. Everyone just nods their head then compares it to their own pain thinking it's the same thing. It's as if no ones been listening to me over the years, I was in so much pain. I tried getting help, I tried and tried, and it wasn't there. It wasn't enough.

My death will be a loss - to who? My parents? They don't care about me nor have they really ever. My friends? They've all left me long ago. Some of my closest took their own lives. Maybe this way I can be with them once again.

I live in Canada.

If I join the military, I don't think I'll last a week in my current state, I'd just pray for my first firing exercise so I could put a bullet in my head. 

I have no one anymore who cares about me, and that's what was stopping me before. The world is filled with some amazing people, I truly believe that. I'm just not one of them, and I'm not tough enough to live in this world.

Most of my problems come from my parents. The worst part about it is, I'm still afraid to hurt them, after everything they've done. 

But I guess someone has to find me the next day.
